entries.label: rest
entries.reason: Walking outdoors tires a person. At 2 per simulated minute a rested person wants to sit again after about four hours (500 at 2 per minute is 250 minutes).

licence.content_source: Authored for the Exulanica living society routine model; see the entry reason

entries.label: leisure
entries.reason: The wish for somewhere to walk or something to look at. It grows fastest so that a person with nothing else pressing keeps moving rather than standing still.

licence.content_source: Authored for the Exulanica living society routine model; see the entry reason

entries.label: a meal
entries.reason: Meals roughly every six hours while awake: 700 at 2 per minute is 350 minutes. Societies start after breakfast, so the initial range is low.

licence.content_source: Authored for the Exulanica living society routine model; see the entry reason

entries.label: shopping
entries.reason: Errands come up about once a day: 800 at 1 per minute is a little over thirteen hours.

licence.content_source: Authored for the Exulanica living society routine model; see the entry reason

entries.label: sleep
entries.reason: Awake about thirteen to sixteen hours a day: 800 at 1 per minute is 800 minutes. Societies start in the morning, so the initial range is low.
